question.wording: Was every dividend in this Form 1099-DIV box 1b paid on stock held at least 61 days in the 121-day period around its ex-dividend date?

options.label: Yes — box 1b is qualified as printed
No — none of box 1b meets the holding period

default.because: Dividends the payer reports as qualified are qualified unless a preparer says the holding period was not met

citation.wording: Dividends you received on any share of stock that you held for less than 61 days during the 121-day period that began 60 days before the ex-dividend date.
